title: S3 reusable reduced response (star eta(Pi) map): preregistration, frozen before any held-out solve
mechanism: assembly.star-k2 (composed_chain.build_star, n_rim=200 recipe, gamma=1.0 J/wu^2), solver patch-equilibrium-solver-v2

P1_node_set.source: s=1.0 reference rows of the load-domain study (loads 0.0..2.0 N), all in-gate; matched-Pi S1 cells at other scales are NOT nodes (used as retained cross-checks)

P2_scheme.selected: Fritsch-Carlson monotone cubic Hermite (PCHIP-equivalent, shape-preserving; no overshoot possible on the strictly monotone table)
P2_scheme.rejected: linear interpolation (LOO worst 1.676e-03 > 16x TOL_ETA) and non-monotone splines (overshoot risk, excluded a priori)
P2_scheme.selection_rule: worst interior-node leave-one-node-out error, node set only

P3_metric: max over fresh held-out cells of |eta_pred(Pi) - eta_meas(s,F)|

P4_threshold.justification: = S1 TOL_ETA; >= 545x the measured stagnation floor 1.831e-07 (never below the noise floor); conservative double-gap LOO stress 2.569e-04 does not apply to the single-gap held-out design (expected order <= 1e-5)

P7_noise_decomposition.empirical: matched-Pi spread among fresh cells at the same Pi (2-solve solver noise), compared to the S1 floor 1.831e-07
P7_noise_decomposition.diagnostic: re-solve worst fresh cell with max_steps=120000; report |deta| sensitivity (not gated)

must_refuse.reason: F above packet cap max_force_N=2.0 (S0 gap 2 conflict noted, not resolved)

caveats_on_valid: no self-intersection/ground-crossing refusal exists (S0 gap 3); within the valid window eta >= 0.111 so the apex stays above the rim plane
dynamics not excluded (S0 gap 7): quasistatic only

P9_benefit.detailed: build_star + solve_equilibrium to convergence (wall clock incl. geometry build)
P9_benefit.reduced: validity query + table interpolation, >=1000 repeats, median per query
P9_benefit.ratio: total detailed wall / (median reduced x n_cells); measured, no minimum gate

P10_failed_S3: (b) any fresh solve out of the 1e-6 N gate/unnamed state
(c) any refusal probe accepted or accept probe refused
(d) tabulation not reproducing pinned source cells
passivity_note: static response map: no dynamics, so passivity/energy balance is NOT APPLICABLE (S0 gap 7); if dynamics enter later, energy-balance/passivity of the relaxation and an inertia characterization would apply; the eta(Pi) monotonicity check is a STATIC CONSISTENCY check, not conservation.
no_solve_declaration: this preregistration script imports NO solver and runs NO solve; all numbers come from published cells
